hypothesis: Math.trunc in the random-line midpoint/roughness calculations repeats the Lua real-division mistake and changes generated geometry.
supportedSetup: Direct exported selection_randline at valid integer map coordinates with roughness0/7 and recursion12; shipped Bar-strt.lua wizard level loads at prechosen seeds28103001/28103002. No natural-arrival search or gameplay edits.
expectedC: selection_do_randline is C, not a translated Lua arithmetic expression. coordxy/schar operands promote to integers; sums/2, rough/2 and rough*2/3 truncate. rec<1 or identical endpoints returns without adding a point. Midpoint recursion executes left then right.
observedJS: All five direct point sets match the verbatim extracted C helper: odd/even midpoint, equal-endpoint control, and two rough paths at Barbarian-start endpoints. C rn2 adapter checks every requested bound, value range and final draw count against the same explicit stream used by JS. Both full C/JS level streams match, with 4586/3982 RNG entries and 27 screens/cursors each.
negativeProof: For valid bounded integer map coordinates and nonnegative roughness, the cited source operations are integer C division, so Math.trunc implements their semantics. Replacing these with real division would be a new divergence. This refutes the arithmetic-origin hypothesis; it does not certify coordinate-frame conversion, rejection behavior for arbitrary inputs, or every level seed.
control: Even midpoint and identical-endpoint direct cases; two independent rough-path streams. The degenerate case is empty in both C and JS, so it is not evidence of a missing initial endpoint.
oracle: probe.mjs extracts the actual pinned selection_do_randline function and compiles it with Clang. Only point storage and rn2 are adapted. coordxy is represented as int for these small bounded values; schar remains signed char. RN2 values are supplied from the seeded JS stream, so the direct oracle compares algorithm/state/draw schedule, not independent PRNG implementation. Fresh full recorder captures provide independent C/JS PRNG-stream comparisons.
rawCaveat: The Lua adapter calls both attempts unresolved because it sees C selvar.c RNG attribution rather than a Bar-strt.lua Lua-frame marker. That raw status is preserved. At filename-submit step26 each C recording has 14 selection_do_randline calls; this corroborates execution without overriding the adapter status.
